skill.name: onboarding-cro
skill.description: Helps teams audit and improve post-signup onboarding, user activation, first-run experience, empty states, checklists, and time-to-value.
skill.summary: Optimize post-signup onboarding so new users reach activation faster.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The static command-execution findings are false positives from Markdown code fences used for examples. The system-reconnaissance finding is also a false positive from a related skill name, and no semantic prompt injection or malicious intent was found.

static_findings.snippet: - **paywall-upgrade-cro**: For converting to paid during/after onboarding

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 122 starts a Markdown fenced example for an onboarding checklist item. It does not invoke a shell, execute Ruby, or process user input.
Line 126 closes the same Markdown example block. The surrounding text is product onboarding guidance, not executable code.

content.value_statement: New users often leave before they experience core product value. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code design faster activation paths.
actual_capabilities: Defines activation goals and aha moments for products.
Audits post-signup flows for friction and drop-off risk.
Designs onboarding checklists, empty states, tooltips, and milestone messages.
Plans behavior-based onboarding emails and in-app recovery prompts.
Suggests experiments for time-to-value, activation, and retention metrics.
limitations: Requires product context and activation data for precise recommendations.
Does not replace analytics instrumentation or user research.
Does not optimize the signup form itself.
Does not create complete lifecycle email campaigns beyond onboarding support.

use_cases.title: Audit a SaaS onboarding flow
use_cases.description: Identify where new accounts lose momentum and prioritize changes that shorten time-to-value.

use_cases.title: Design first-run product states
use_cases.description: Create checklists, empty states, and guided prompts that help users complete their first valuable action.

use_cases.title: Plan activation experiments
use_cases.description: Turn onboarding hypotheses into tests with metrics, variants, and success criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Review my onboarding
prompt_templates.prompt: Review our post-signup onboarding flow and identify the top three activation blockers.

prompt_templates.title: Create a checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an onboarding checklist for a B2B SaaS product with five steps and benefit-focused microcopy.

prompt_templates.title: Improve empty states
prompt_templates.prompt: Write empty state copy and CTAs that guide new users toward their first meaningful action.

prompt_templates.title: Build an experiment plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an onboarding experiment plan with hypotheses, variants, metrics, segments, and rollout priorities.

output_examples.input: Our analytics tool loses most users before they install tracking.
output_examples.output: The skill would recommend a guided setup, sample data preview, installation checklist, stalled-user emails, and activation metrics.

output_examples.input: Our project tool has a blank dashboard after signup.
output_examples.output: The skill would propose an empty state with a project template CTA, quick-start copy, and a first teammate invitation prompt.

best_practices: Define activation as one measurable behavior linked to retention.
Lead users to one valuable outcome before teaching advanced features.
Measure each onboarding step with cohort and source segmentation.
anti_patterns: Do not force long tours before users can try the product.
Do not treat every feature as an onboarding priority.
Do not use empty states that only explain missing data.

faq.question: What does this skill optimize?
faq.answer: It optimizes post-signup onboarding, activation, first-run experience, empty states, checklists, and time-to-value.

faq.question: Does it help with signup forms?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on what happens after signup. Use a signup flow skill for registration optimization.

faq.question: What inputs improve the results?
faq.answer: Share product type, activation definition, current flow, drop-off points, and activation metrics.

faq.question: Can it write onboarding copy?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft welcome screens, checklist items, empty states, tooltips, emails, and milestone messages.

faq.question: Can it design experiments?
faq.answer: Yes. It suggests onboarding experiments with hypotheses, variants, metrics, and priorities.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
